creator: Alexander Terp
description:
Requests that come from the CLI still ride the 500ms budget `HerdrClient::DEFAULT_TIMEOUT` gives keystrokes. A CLI request is not on the typing path, so nobody is waiting on it at keystroke speed, but it times out as though it were.

Since `5a5abb4` such a timeout reads as `unanswered` (exit 4) rather than as a refusal, which is honest. It still fails: the `daemon_settings` test flake is this. Whether CLI-originated intents should get the session's longer allowance instead is the decision this card is for.
title: CLI requests time out on the 500ms budget keystrokes get
